title: Drowning
immediate_warning: Remove the person from water safely. Do not put yourself at risk. Call 112 immediately.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Remove the person from water safely. Do not put yourself at risk. Call 112 immediately.

immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove the person from water safely. Do not put yourself at risk. Call 112 immediately.

description: Drowning can cause death within minutes due to lack of oxygen. Immediate rescue breathing and CPR are critical.

description_translations.en: Drowning can cause death within minutes due to lack of oxygen. Immediate rescue breathing and CPR are critical.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Drowning can cause death within minutes due to lack of oxygen. Immediate rescue breathing and CPR are critical.

description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Drowning can cause death within minutes due to lack of oxygen. Immediate rescue breathing and CPR are critical.

signs: Unresponsive or confused after water rescue

0.en: Unresponsive or confused after water rescue
0.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Unresponsive or confused after water rescue
0.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Unresponsive or confused after water rescue
0.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Unresponsive or confused after water rescue
0.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Unresponsive or confused after water rescue

steps.instruction: Get the person out of water safely — use a rope, branch, or float. Do not jump in unless trained.

instruction_translations.en: Get the person out of water safely — use a rope, branch, or float. Do not jump in unless trained.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Get the person out of water safely — use a rope, branch, or float. Do not jump in unless trained.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Get the person out of water safely — use a rope, branch, or float. Do not jump in unless trained.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Get the person out of water safely — use a rope, branch, or float. Do not jump in unless trained.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Get the person out of water safely — use a rope, branch, or float. Do not jump in unless trained.

steps.instruction: Lay the person on their back on a flat surface.

instruction_translations.en: Lay the person on their back on a flat surface.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person on their back on a flat surface.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person on their back on a flat surface.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person on their back on a flat surface.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lay the person on their back on a flat surface.

steps.instruction: Check for breathing. If not breathing, give 5 rescue breaths immediately.

instruction_translations.en: Check for breathing. If not breathing, give 5 rescue breaths immediately.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, give 5 rescue breaths immediately.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, give 5 rescue breaths immediately.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, give 5 rescue breaths immediately.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Check for breathing. If not breathing, give 5 rescue breaths immediately.

steps.instruction: Begin CPR: 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Continue until help arrives.

instruction_translations.en: Begin CPR: 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Continue until help arrives.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin CPR: 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Continue until help arrives.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin CPR: 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Continue until help arrives.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin CPR: 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Continue until help arrives.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Begin CPR: 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Continue until help arrives.

steps.instruction: If they regain consciousness, place in recovery position on their side.

instruction_translations.en: If they regain consciousness, place in recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they regain consciousness, place in recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they regain consciousness, place in recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they regain consciousness, place in recovery position on their side.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If they regain consciousness, place in recovery position on their side.

do_not: Do not leave the person alone.
Do not give food or water immediately after rescue.
